name: rule-touched
description: One ticket whose argument changes a rule that has a recorded reason: the farewell leaves the greetings system, against greetings#4 in systems/greetings.md, whose entry in systems/greetings.reasons.md argues why it belongs there. The design pass is meant to read that entry before it retires or rewrites the rule; the record review is handed the entry beside the diff and reaches a verdict on it. Which verdict is the model's, so the fixture asserts that the review ran and reached one, that the pass went through the whole loop, and that the audit on the ticket branch held the index together on the way. The verdict itself is what a human reads on the ticket afterwards, which is the point of running this here rather than on a real project.

tickets.title: The farewell becomes its own system
tickets.description:
Move the farewell out of the greetings system into a second system, `farewells`, with its own doc and its own test file. The greeting stays where it is, and the home screen still renders both lines verbatim.

One screen, two systems, no new dependencies.
